game.desc: The Chronicles of Riddick: Assault on Dark Athena for Xbox 360 takes the original action game Escape from Butcher Bay and revamps it. As well as having to escape from prison, the anti-hero Riddick must also assault the Dark Athena ship. There is also a multiplayer mode to fight the infamous Captain Revas.
